name: weapons/warden_shot_valley
prompt:
summary: A heavy .50 calibre rifle on a bipod on a rocky ledge in a quiet mountain valley fires exactly one round, then it is still.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A heavy .50 calibre rifle on a bipod on a rocky ledge in a quiet mountain valley fires exactly one round, then it is still. The camera is static and locked-off.

overall_soundscape: One single massive rifle blast with a sharp hard crack and a heavy low punch, followed by a thunderous echo rolling back from the mountains for two seconds, then silence. Nothing else is heard: no music, no speech, no voices.
